title: /support loads and renders the ticket table (or empty state) without a runtime error
expectedResult: Page renders the 'User Support' header, search/filter bar, and either a populated ticket table or the 'No support tickets yet' empty state — no unhandled exception or blank screen.

title: Submitting a minimal valid bug report succeeds end-to-end
steps: Open the Report a Bug modal
Enter a 20-character description with no screenshot
expectedResult: A success toast appears referencing a generated ticket number, and POST /bug-reports responds 201.

title: Core bug-report routes are mounted and reachable
description: Confirms bug-report.routes.js is wired into the Express app and none of its core routes 404.
steps: With a valid auth token, call GET /bug-reports
Call POST /bug-reports/webhook/jira with an empty body
expectedResult: GET /bug-reports returns 200 (own tickets). GET /bug-reports/all returns either 200 (if permitted) or 403 (if not) — never 404. The webhook route responds 401 (secret missing/mismatched), never 404, confirming it is registered ahead of the `router.use(authenticate)` line.

title: Row action menu shows the correct Reopen/Close option for the ticket's current status
preconditions: One ticket with status Open and one with status Closed exist
steps: Open the action menu (⋮) on the Open ticket's row
Open the action menu on the Closed ticket's row
expectedResult: The Open ticket's menu shows 'View Details' and 'Close' (no 'Re-Open'); the Closed ticket's menu shows 'View Details' and 'Re-Open' (no 'Close') — clicking either does not throw.

title: Opening a ticket's detail drawer loads the comment thread without error
preconditions: An existing ticket, synced or unsynced
steps: Click a ticket row to open the detail drawer
expectedResult: The Comments section renders — either the fetched comment list, or 'No comments yet. Start the conversation below.' for an unsynced/commentless ticket — with no console error or spinner stuck indefinitely.
